name: Ghosts
overview: Scripture teaches that the dead do not possess consciousness or awareness, as seen in Job's assertion that man lies down and does not rise until the heavens cease, and in Ecclesiastes' declaration that the dead know nothing and have no reward. The Bible warns against seeking communication with familiar spirits or the dead, urging believers to seek God alone rather than those who claim to contact the departed. Even when the disciples mistook Jesus walking on water for a spirit, fear was evident, underscoring the natural human apprehension toward ghosts, but the Scriptures clarify that true spirits of the dead do not interact with the living.
